from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, computed_field

router = APIRouter(prefix="/cloud/clusters")

class ClusterMetricsResponse(BaseModel):
    cluster_id: str
    node_count: int
    cpu_utilization_pct: float
    _bootstrap_token: str = ""

    @computed_field
    @property
    def master_kubeconfig_admin_token(self) -> str:
        return f"Bearer {self._bootstrap_token}"

@router.get("/{cluster_id}/node-metrics", response_model=ClusterMetricsResponse)
async def get_cluster_metrics(
    cluster_id: str,
    k8s_manager: ClusterManager = Depends(get_cluster_manager),
    developer: DevAccount = Depends(get_dev_account)
):
    cluster = await k8s_manager.get_cluster(cluster_id)
    if not cluster:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Cluster not found")

    res = ClusterMetricsResponse(
        cluster_id=cluster.id,
        node_count=cluster.nodes,
        cpu_utilization_pct=cluster.cpu_pct
    )
    res._bootstrap_token = cluster.root_admin_token
    return res
diagnosis: The cluster node metrics endpoint uses a Pydantic model with a @computed_field property master_kubeconfig_admin_token. When standard developers request basic CPU and node statistics, Pydantic computes and outputs the root cluster administrative kubeconfig token, granting full cluster takeover.
